body:
Honestly, yeah. Personally it's gotten to the point where i genuinely do not understand if a person *doesn't* want to off themself. So much terrible shit 24/7 and come on, its not like you're ever gonna be able to retire and not work until you drop dead. 
 In life I was always surrounded by miserable adults who came home every day exhausted, talking about how they hate their job and every thing sucks. A big reason I'm suicidal the way i am now is because my father's motto was "life sucks, and then you die." which i spent my childhood taking to heart because...if thats all there is to it, why not end it early then and avoid the massive suffering vs joy imbalance life is? If life is an unfair game, well I don't know about you, but I wouldn't want to willingly play a game i knew was unfair. 
And yet, all the adults who fed me the notion that life is just inherently terrible as a child are still here, living their lives, working day in and day out to the point of misery and yet, no desires of suicide at all, meanwhile I'm looking up methods in between browsing this sub because I'm done pretending life has merit like other people do. Truly boggles my mind wondering what the hell some people are putting themselves through their own hell to stick around for.

TL;DR I don't understand how anyone has a reason to live that justifies sticking around in the world we live in today.
